description: Create a new author for blog articles (a default avatar is assigned if none is passed; use generate_blog_author for an AI-written persona). Returns an authorId that can be used in generate_blog_post and update_blog_article. Only firstName/lastName are required — pass the bio/social fields too so bylines aren't name-only.

about.description: Short author bio shown on their byline/archive page.

avatar.description: Avatar image URL for the author's byline.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

website.description: Author's website URL (distinct from the personal/portfolio `url` field).

name: create_blog_author
